name: Calendar Icon
description: Calendar icon with multiple animation variations for scheduling and date-related interactions

variations.name: page-flip
variations.description: Calendar body rotates in 3D along the top edge like flipping a physical calendar page. Header with binding rings stays fixed. Perfect for month navigation.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isFlipping
props.description: Triggers the page flip animation. Set to true to flip the calendar page.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the page flip in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the page flip. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: picker-open
variations.description: Calendar body splits and opens like a book on hover. Left half slides left, right half slides right. Perfect for date picker buttons that open calendars.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Controls the opening animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the glass/solid crossfade in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: slide-month
variations.description: Date dots slide out to the left and new dots slide in from the right when month changes. Calendar body and header stay fixed.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: monthKey
props.description: Unique key for current month. Change this value to trigger the slide animation (e.g., month index or timestamp).

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the dot slide in seconds; the enter delay scales with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the dots sliding in. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
